homepage.headline: Where Cultures Connect.
homepage.introduction: Atlas is a student-led publication exploring the cultures, stories and perspectives that shape our world. From personal reflections and literary expression to travel, identity and global conversations, we bring together voices across borders, celebrating both what makes us different and what connects us.

about.headline: Many Perspectives. One Atlas.
about.introduction: Atlas was founded to create a space where different cultures, experiences and ideas can meet. We believe storytelling has the power to broaden perspectives, challenge assumptions and build connections across communities. Through journalism, creative writing and personal narratives, we aim to amplify diverse voices and encourage meaningful conversations.
about.missionHeadline: A publication where different cultures, experiences and ideas can meet.
about.missionDescription: Atlas is a student-led international literary and cultural magazine. It brings together journalism, creative writing and personal narratives from across the student community, with the aim of broadening perspectives and building connection.

submissions.headline: Your voice belongs in Atlas. Share your perspective.
submissions.introduction: Whether you are an undergraduate testing your first verses or a postgraduate carrying a dispatch from your hometown, ATLAS invites all LSE students, researchers, and alumni to submit unpublished work.
